Headquarters: Toronto, Ontario
 
URL: https://c4media.com/

C4Media, Inc. is looking for a Demand Generation Specialist (Contractor) to join our fully remote, global team.

You’ll own digital marketing campaigns that drive QCon registrations, certification enrollments, and InfoQ Live registrations. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where you’ll write copy, manage email campaigns and audience segments, run paid advertising, analyze performance, and continuously improve our marketing processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who enjoys building repeatable campaigns, reaching new audiences, and writing compelling content for a technical audience of senior software engineers and architects. Experience with marketing conferences, certifications, courses, or professional development is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

• Own end-to-end demand generation campaigns for QCon, certifications, and InfoQ Live.

• Create email sequences, landing page copy, social posts, and paid ad copy.

• Manage audience segmentation, exclusions, automations, and email campaigns.

• Plan and execute organic and paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, and social channels.

• Track and report weekly on registrations, enrollments, cost per registration, and revenue.

• Maintain marketing dashboards, trackers, and campaign calendars.

• Test new channels and strategies to reach audiences beyond our existing database.

• Build repeatable campaign processes and continuously improve performance.

• Coordinate campaigns across products while managing shared audiences and contact limits.

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, content creation, testing, analysis, and automation.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in digital marketing and demand generation, with a strong focus on email and lifecycle marketing.

• Proven experience driving measurable registrations, enrollments, leads, or sales.

• Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting skills for technical audiences.

• Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, and organic social media.

• Strong analytical and reporting skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

• A proactive approach to staying current with marketing platforms, tools, trends, and best practices.

• Comfortable using AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity.

Remote Work Requirements

• Must reside in Europe

• Able to work in a full-time remote position

• Able to work in overlap with our core global office hours (9 AM - 1 PM EST)

• Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-office setup

• Willing and able to travel to the USA or Europe 1–3 times per year for conferences and company meetings

Why work at C4Media

• Work from home - always: We are a remote-first and remote-always team that has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that.

• Travel the world: C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences & team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip.

• Take care of each other: We look out for one another and prioritize respect, fairness, support, and well-being. Check out our core values on our careers page.

• Learn something new: C4Media’s culture is one of learning & mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it.

• Make friends across the world: Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life.

• Support wellbeing: In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness.

• Generous paid time off: In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education.

Qualified candidates are to submit their applications on our C4Media website. Only candidates who submit their applications in English will be considered for this role (including resume).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/c4media-inc-demand-generation-specialist

7fa740940ff91fe5.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Software Engineer Intern for a duration of 6 months, starting on January 12th 2027. 

About the job

This position is needed to design, develop, deploy and operate software solutions and help Twilio deliver real-time, low latency capabilities for next-generation communications. Twilio Interns in Software Engineering are eager to learn and inspire and like to think at scale and meet high availability goals, bringing a focus to solving resiliency, latency and quality challenges in our virtualized cloud environment. Software Engineers want to develop technical skills and industry experience while working on complex distributed systems.

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer Intern you will experience the following -

  • Be a Software Engineer, not just an "intern".
  • Ship many different projects during the 6 months. 
  • Learn from passionate engineers at Twilio who solve problems in distributed computing, real-time DSP (audio processing), virtualization performance, distributed messaging, buses and more.
  • You will be given responsibility for core features and services that ship to our users.
  • You will be expected to embrace these challenges, learn fast and deliver great results.
  • You will bring a willingness to learn and grow and we will reciprocate with ample opportunity to do just that, in a friendly, fun and exciting startup environment! 
  • Learn to develop beautiful and profitable applications.
  • Demonstrate consistent improvement in your coding skills, issue-tracking and source control systems, and agile development mentality.
  • Participate in code reviews, bug tracking and project management with the rest of the Twilio Team. 

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required

  • To be working towards a Bachelors or Masters in computer science. 
  • To have a keen interest in software development with several side projects and perhaps are a part of the open source community.
  • To have a hungry entrepreneurial and "can do" spirit, as evidenced by successful interest in learning new technologies.
  • To have explored writing code in any of the following languages: Python/Java/Javascript/PHP/C or C++.

Desired

  • Having knowledge of unit and integration testing methodologies, and the ability to write, debug and deploy testing frameworks.
  • Experience in data processing, analytics, business intelligence, and reporting.
  • Experience with technologies such as Hadoop, spark, python, scala etc.

Location 

This role will be remote and based in India. Please note that you’d need to be located in one of the following five states for the duration of the internship: Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra & Delhi. 

What We Offer

There are many benefits to interning at Twilio, including competitive pay, generous time off, and flexible working! Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

7f69a8b0cef7b6ed.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The BizTech BI&Analytics team partners with business and finance stakeholders to deliver scalable self-serve analytics & AI transformation programs, budgeting & forecasting solutions, reliable data pipelines, and trusted metrics & dashboards. Empowering timely, compliant, data-driven decisions and a robust analytics foundation across Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are seeking a skilled Senior Systems Engineer to support our Oracle EPM Planning systems and processes, with a strong focus on bringing AI automation and AI agent capabilities into Finance workflows. This is an important role within the Airbnb BizTech organization supporting Finance. The ideal candidate combines solid technical depth in the Finance Budgeting and Forecasting function with hands-on experience building AI automation and AI agents. Responsibilities include financial forecast modeling, system and AI-driven process transformation, integration with the data warehouse, and translating business requirements into scalable Oracle EPM and AI-enabled solutions.

A Typical Day:

Technical Support & System Admin

  • Application: Support the design, configuration, and maintenance of Oracle EPM Planning modules (Financials, Workforce, Capital, Cash Forecast, Long Range Planning, etc).
  • Calculations & Modeling: Develop and maintain business rules and calc scripts. Proficiency in Groovy Scripting for data and forecast modeling.
  • Data Integration: Support data flows with AWS data warehouse, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Workday, leveraging Data Management, EPM Automate, and internal Airbnb integration tools.
  • Environment Management: Assist with the monthly Oracle patch cycle, including regression testing and impact analysis of new features.

FP&A Functional Support

  • Process Improvement: Partner with FP&A to streamline the budget and forecasting process by automating manual offline models and enhancing data integration to reduce forecast cycle time and improve accuracy.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain reports using EPM Reports; support finance users in Smart View with ad-hoc analysis and template creation.
  • User Support: Support the monthly forecast cycle, resolving issues promptly and engaging Oracle support when needed.

AI Automation & Agent Development

  • AI Agent Building: Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that streamline FP&A processes, using both native EPM AI capabilities and external AI/automation tooling.
  • Process Automation: Identify manual, repetitive finance and systems processes and apply AI automation to reduce cycle time and manual effort.
  • Collaboration: Work with Finance and Tech partners to prioritize AI automation opportunities and deliver AI-generated forecasts, analyses, and insights.

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Oracle Hyperion/EPM (minimum 2 years in EPM Cloud). Experience with EPM Automate, Groovy scripting, building forms, reports, application optimization, and administering user access.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting finance functions (FP&A, Accounting, Treasury, Tax) with solid financial statement literacy.
  • Hands-on experience building AI automation and AI agents (for example, agentic workflows, LLM-based automation using tooling such as Claude, Gemini, GPT - not specific to EPM's built-in AI).
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation, pipeline troubleshooting, and ad-hoc analysis against warehouse tables.
  • Experience supporting integrations between Oracle EPM and ERP via OIC or equivalent middleware.
  • Experience operating data orchestration and ETL/ELT pipelines: monitoring workflow health, managing and re-running failed tasks, reviewing execution logs, and coordinating pipeline incidents with owning teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work with cross-functional stakeholders and clearly document technical processes for non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions within or outside of EPM Planning, and to recommend options for decision making.

 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
  • Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
  • Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
  • Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
  • Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
  • Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
  • Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

What you will bring

  • Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
  • Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
  • Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
  • Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
  • Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
  • Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
  • Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
  • Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
  • Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
  • Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
  • Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
  • Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
  • Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

About the team: The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave
